_readme: One source of truth for the SEO tags. Edit this file, then run from the repo root: python3 tools/seo.py
python3 tools/seo.py --check changes nothing and fails if a page is out of date or a rule is broken (run it before committing).

site_url: leave empty until the domain is live, then set it, e.g. https://castrosconsultoria.co.mz (no trailing slash) and run seo.py again. That adds canonical, og:url, og:image, the WebSite data, sitemap.xml and robots.txt.
Titles: 30-60 characters (Google cuts longer ones). Descriptions: 70-160 characters. Portuguese is what Google sees; title.en only feeds the browser tab when the visitor switches to EN.

business.telephone / business.email: empty on purpose. The site shows +258 87 866 5180 and +258 84 866 5180, and three different email addresses; fill these in once the client confirms which ones are right.
business.same_as: only real profile URLs (the Facebook and LinkedIn links on the site are still placeholders).
